name: robotregistryfoundation
description: Plugins for the robot-md ecosystem and adjacent developer tooling — declare robots with ROBOT.md, keep AI-driven motion behind a gate and test it with Bounded Embodiment, and expose work safely to agents.

plugins.name: graft-robotics
plugins.description: Graft Robotics v0.5.0 MCP App & Workbench (19 MCP tools, 7 Playbooks, 4 Form Elicitations, 5 live Resources): pair Claude Code, Antigravity, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Apple Silicon MLX, or local Gemma 4 safely with physical robots. Includes ROS 2 Pre-Flight Launch Bundle generator (graft_ros2_generate_bundle), opt-in Cloudflare D1 Hosted Fleet Vault status (graft_vault_status, zero phone-home when unset), 6-client Agent Connect (graft_connect_agent), 1-click ISO 10218:2025 & EU 2023/1230 Compliance Dossier ZIP (graft_generate_compliance_pack, 0 private keys), /ros2-compliance-audit & /remote-shop-onboarding playbooks, live Wedge A-Upmarket Workbench side pane, 6-family Hand HAL, Rust graft-core + MuJoCo 4.0.1 physics, Semantic-to-Deterministic Ratchet, and fail-closed L0-L3 Trust Ladder.

plugins.name: robot-md
plugins.description: Connect a robot to Claude through its ROBOT.md: the using-robot-md, bounded-embodiment and rrf-registry skills, the enable-dispatch command, and the robot-md MCP server for manifest reads and gated motion.

plugins.name: bounded-embodiment
plugins.description: Bundles the bounded-embodiment skill: keeps AI-driven motion behind a gate, drafts envelopes for the integrator to decide, rehearses EV-03 and EV-10 in simulation with bounded-embodiment-kit, reads verdicts honestly (a simulation is always INCONCLUSIVE; consistent is not passed), and prepares hardware commands for a person at the machine to run.

plugins.name: market-validation
plugins.description: Validate whether there is a real market for a product idea: multi-angle web research with live-URL verification → cited evidence pack → Tufte HTML deck + PDF/PPTX → a build/integrate brief and an emitted workflow-atlas market map. Cross-listed from the founder-skills marketplace.

plugins.name: build-options
plugins.description: Decide what to build after a market is validated: divergent options → independent judge-panel weighted decision matrix → adversarial stress-test → a recommended build with kill criteria. Chains into the prd → tasks skills. Cross-listed from the founder-skills marketplace.

plugins.name: prd
plugins.description: Generate a Product Requirements Document for a new feature: self-clarify the open questions, then produce a clear, actionable, implementation-ready PRD. Chains after build-options and into tasks. Cross-listed from the founder-skills marketplace.

plugins.name: tasks
plugins.description: Convert a PRD markdown file into a prd.json task plan: extract tasks and explode each into granular, machine-verifiable sub-tasks with acceptance criteria. Chains after prd. Cross-listed from the founder-skills marketplace.
